evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund distributed automatically, plus $2 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Class relief and fees were addressed during the same negotiation process; fees were not first discussed only after class relief was agreed.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised attorneys’ fees in their opening public settlement proposals, before the class fund amount was resolved. Fees and class relief were negotiated in the same process, but the transcript does not show any tradeoff linking fee treatment to a lower class recovery. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized firm economics, that defense leveraged fee interests, or that the court declaration was misleading.
